title: Projection and homology compatible restriction comparisons for cycle evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme and T,J integer cochain complexes of X-modules [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions]. For opens V of X and W of V, let F be restriction to V followed by restriction to the site over W, A=F(T), K=F(J), P=Hom(T,J) and Q=Hom(A,K) [def-pur-hom-complex]. Write ev=P.iCycles(n);pi;Hom(T.iCycles(-n),1), and ev'=Q.iCycles(n);pi';Hom(A.iCycles(-n),1), with the fixed projections [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. There exist isomorphisms a:F(H^n(P))->H^n(Q), b:F(Hom(H^(-n)(T),H^0(J)))->Hom(H^(-n)(A),H^0(K)), c:F(Z^n(P))->Z^n(Q), s:F(Hom(Z^(-n)(T),Z^0(J)))->Hom(Z^(-n)(A),Z^0(K)), t:F(Hom(Z^(-n)(T),J^0))->Hom(Z^(-n)(A),K^0), and v:F(Hom(Z^(-n)(T),H^0(J)))->Hom(Z^(-n)(A),H^0(K)) [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. They satisfy the five equations F(ev);t=c;ev', F(Hom(1,J.iCycles(0)));t=s;Hom(1,K.iCycles(0)), F(Hom(1,J.homologyPi(0)));v=s;Hom(1,K.homologyPi(0)), F(P.homologyPi(n));a=c;Q.homologyPi(n), and F(Hom(T.homologyPi(-n),1));v=b;Hom(A.homologyPi(-n),1). No evaluation morphism on homology is assumed or constructed.

source.place: section-hom-complexes: product terms and signed differential. Tag 08DL: restriction comparison construction. This refines steps 1 and 2 of new-e3-homology-evaluation-restriction-comparison.

proof.text: Obtain a natural internal-Hom comparison e and its naturality he for composite restriction.

Use e and he to obtain a,c and the Hom-cycle projection and quotient squares. Separately use e and he to obtain b,s,t,v and the four internal-Hom inclusion and quotient transport squares. Neither intermediate statement contains the other part of the argument.

Combine the Hom-cycle projection square with the square for Hom(T.iCycles,identity). Functor.map_comp and associativity give the raw evaluation square. The other four required squares are exactly the separately obtained inclusion and quotient squares. Insert the six isomorphisms as existential witnesses.

proof_origin.description: Genuine decomposition into independent projection/cycle and internal-Hom transport squares, combined by a proved categorical composition lemma. No restatement core.
